description: Search the term names, abstracts and definitions for a keyword or phrase and return the best matches, each with its abstract. Use it when the right term is not known in advance.

limit.description: How many matches to return, best first. Defaults to 8.

query.description: The words to search for, e.g. 'overfitting' or 'gradient step size'. Matching is case-insensitive; a term whose name contains the query ranks above one where only the definition does.

name: search_terms
title: Search the dictionary
